The story

Built from the inside of the problem.

Most software is designed by people who studied the problem from a safe distance. Ours is designed by a man who lived it. ProsaY exists because Michael Jeffrey Spencer walked into a Smith County courtroom representing himself, faced three attorneys across the table, and won. He came out knowing exactly what an unprepared person is up against in that room, and he started building the tool that person needed.

That is the pattern under everything at HCC. Spades Blast comes from a lifetime at the table. X-plore comes from watching an entire industry turn human attention into a slot machine and deciding to build the opposite.

Underneath all of it sits A Lifelong Forge, published in 2025: the Harmonic Life Force Theory, and its core claim, the Law of Resistance. Power is born through opposition, in physics and in the soul. HCC builds like that is true, because around here it has been proven the hard way.

We do not scrape together imitations of what already exists. We build from first principles, we state plainly what is finished and what is not, and every product answers to one standard: surpass everything else in its market, for the person it serves.

The work

Four builds. One standard.

Each one aimed at a moment when a person stands alone and the stakes are real. Status is stated plainly on every one, and it always will be.

ProsaY

Court preparation
In rebuild

Have your SAY in court.

ProsaY walks a person through building a case in one clear flow, from the first fact to a finished filing. It was designed from the experience of walking into a courtroom unprepared, so nobody else has to.

  • Prepare. Practice. Perform. Build the case, rehearse in the courtroom simulator, then export and walk in ready.
  • Case Builder is step zero. Evidence Vault, document review, and a complete motion library live inside the flow.
  • Verification before trust. Claims get checked before they ever reach a filing.
  • Now in a full Flutter rebuild with the web demo live for demonstrations.

Spades Blast

Competitive spades game
In development

Cosmic Competitive Spades

A competitive spades game built for players who take the table seriously. Climb from NEWBIE to QUANTUM, play in first person at a living table, and feel every trick land.

  • Modes: ranked 2v2, 1v1, and free for all, plus tournaments, duel draft, and practice against AI.
  • Free to play with cosmetics. Ranked play is subscribers only at $4.99 a month.
  • Your rank stays yours. A lapsed subscription pauses ranked play and never wipes your rank.
  • Built to the master spec, milestone by milestone, with the trick zone always in clear sight.

X-plore

Dating and connection
In development

Powered by Claer

A dating app built around sincerity instead of swiping volume. Claer matches on resonance, and the design protects attention. Attention is sacred here, never flooded.

  • No likes anywhere. Ten sparks a day total, whether you spark or ghost, so every choice means something.
  • Touch rituals are rare by design. A weekly ritual goes only to someone you truly want to reach.
  • Whispers change with the sender. The conversation takes on the color of the person who wrote last.
  • Verified people only. Liveness checks at every level, with stronger verification as access grows.

A Lifelong Forge

Research and theory
Published 2025

The Harmonic Life Force Theory

The research underneath everything HCC builds. Written by Michael Jeffrey Spencer as an independent researcher and published in 2025, it argues one claim across physics and the soul: power is born through opposition.

  • The Law of Resistance is the core claim, mapped across 63 scientific principles.
  • A full scripture analysis sits alongside the science, tested against the same claim.
  • It is the anchor document behind Claer and the HCC design philosophy.

The founder

Michael Jeffrey Spencer

Owner and CEO of Harmonic Custom Concepts, East Texas. Michael builds from first principles: picture every variable in a system, then move the one nobody else thought could move. A lifetime of practical systems knowledge, construction, mechanical repair, and fabrication, now runs through software.

ProsaY exists because he lived its problem. He represented himself in a Smith County court fight against three attorneys, won his judgment, and came out knowing exactly what an unprepared person is up against in that room. Every HCC product starts the same way: at the moment it has to serve.

His words for the work are simple. Build, repair, create, evolve. In that order, every time.
